An attacker with access to the Glue Data Catalog could discover and access sensitive data that should not have been cataloged.

Insufficient Monitoring and Audit Trail [Repudiation, CWE-778] on DataZoneVpc, RedshiftCluster, AuroraCluster, GlueJob, S3DataLakeCrawler: The architecture lacks proper audit trails and monitoring mechanisms, making it difficult to detect and respond to security incidents. An attacker could perform malicious activities without detection due to insufficient logging and monitoring.
